# Global Energy Atlas

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: global-energy-atlas
Class: evidence_first_energy_systems_education
Canonical URL: https://energy-atlas.base44.app/
Authority: public read-only energy-systems education and evidence exploration
Human confirmation required: no

## Natural-language intents
- compare electricity mixes between regions
- learn how an energy system works
- compare energy flows and grid systems
- study historical changes in electricity generation
- show sourced energy data and provenance
- teach me about regional power systems

## Boundaries
- educational comparisons are not operational grid instructions
- do not present modeled or historical data as live grid state unless explicitly verified
- source provenance and data limitations should remain visible
- does not provide personalized investment advice

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
